regime: Risk-on held and the commodities flipped sides. NQ and ES both extended their longs and closed at session highs. Gold rolled over and flipped short; crude bounced and flipped long. Index volatility ticked up into Jackson Hole. Reduced risk with both index longs stretched at the highs ahead of Friday's Warsh keynote.
summary: Risk-on held and the commodities flipped sides. NQ and ES both extended their longs and closed right at the session highs, NQ up 0.5% to 29,431 and ES up 0.25% to 7,710. NQ took a real dip overnight to 29,095, lost its stop, then reclaimed and rallied straight into the close for a fresh session high. The bigger story was in commodities. Gold rolled over, down 1.4% to 4,613.6, losing its trailing stop and flipping short. Crude did the opposite, bouncing 1% off a 79.62 low to close 81.91 and flip its short back to long. Index volatility ticked up, NQ hourly ATR near 93, all into Jackson Hole.
psychology: A strong close is not a green light to size up. NQ closed at its high, stretched well above its average, right into a major Fed event. That is exactly when chasing feels safest and pays worst. The move already happened. If you missed the reclaim off the overnight low, wait for the next clean setup with a defined stop. The other lesson was in gold: it held up for days, so plenty of traders were anchored long and fought the breakdown. When your trailing stop flips, the position is over. Respect the flip and stand aside rather than adding to a loser.

event.name: Wednesday data cluster (GDP Q2 second estimate, July durable goods, Core PCE)
event.actual: GDP, durable goods and Core PCE all landed before the cash open; equities pushed to session highs and took the data in stride
event.surprise: No single shock. Equities extended risk-on while commodities rotated: gold rolled over, crude bounced
event.nqReaction: NQ dipped overnight to 29,095, reclaimed its stop and rallied to close 29,431 at the session high, up 0.5%. ES closed 7,710, up 0.25%, also at its high.
event.crossAsset: Gold fell 1.4% to 4,613.6 and flipped short. Crude bounced 1% off a 79.62 low to 81.91 and flipped long. Ahead: Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole as Fed Chair, keynote Friday Aug 28. VIX not pulled this run (TrendSpider VIX finicky per Lesson 014); vol read is from equity ATR.

risk.sizing: Both index longs are extended and closed at session highs, with NQ about plus 2.5 sigma above its mean. Do not chase or over-size a stretched close into a Fed event. Keep sizing off the ATR.
risk.openRisk: The commodity flips are fresh, gold short and crude long are both day-one signals, so give them room. Two closes below 29,197 on NQ or 7,675 on ES put those longs on hold; gold reclaiming 4,657 neutralizes the new short; crude losing 81.08 flips it back short.
risk.note: Jackson Hole runs Aug 27 to 29. This is Kevin Warsh's first as Fed Chair and his Friday, Aug 28 keynote is the week's key event risk. Weekly jobless claims land Thursday before the open. Not financial advice.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN
fullReport.html:
HTA OPEN (NY opening range from the 13:30 to 14:00 UTC window): OR high 29,333, OR low 29,174, width 159, set by the 9:30 to 10:00 ET bars. Early cash trade probed the OR low, dipping to the 29,156 RTH low, then reclaimed and rotated up. Late in the session price pushed through the OR high and closed 29,431 at the high. A failed downside probe that resolved to the upside.

For Thursday, BIR, HOF, MID and BNC are all eligible on a Thursday. Treat it with caution anyway: the Jackson Hole symposium opens, so keep the first opening-range break on a short leash.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout
fullReport.html: E3v2 Momentum Long has its filter open, with NQ above its 29,197 stop. After holding the overnight reclaim, price broke the opening-range high and made a fresh session high into the close. The one caution is timing, since the push came late and right ahead of Jackson Hole.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band
fullReport.html: AVWAP deviation band (MNQ): close 29,431 versus AVWAP 29,280 is about plus 2.5 sigma, above the plus 2 band at 29,399. A reversion signal exists here, but it points against a strong trend into event risk. The minus 2 band sits at 29,161. Wait for the setup rather than fading blind.
